tagline: A contemporary gallery translated into a quiet therapeutic space.
typography: Georgia with expansive display sizing; utilitarian Arial captions.
rationale: Museum captions, sculptural artwork and deliberate negative space create a restrained visual identity distinct from wellness templates.
mobile: Art remains full width after text; columns stack; display type reduces without sacrificing hierarchy.
supporting: Anchored profile and approach sections plus expandable visit/fees/access information.
trust: Clear practitioner identification balances the abstract art; practical details remain available and easy to find.
seo: Keep all meaningful messaging in text, with concise decorative art labels; add verified service terminology to production copy.
tradeoff: Abstract art can feel impersonal; the real portrait and warm, specific biography are essential.
name: Quiet Gallery
accessibility: Keep small gallery-style captions legible. The original sculpture is decorative; service, location and contact information remain real text. Avoid overusing faint greys for essential copy.
